subject: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeinc.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Acme Inc. Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team at Acme was impressed with the latency profiles and routing controls. Procurement asked that we map out the vendor onboarding milestones so they can start the Ariba setup. I attached a short MAP draft with the procurement milestones, responsibilities, and dependencies. Can you confirm the owners and a realistic target close date?

High level items they want covered:
- Ariba/Coupa vendor registration (procurement + your finance onboarding team)
- Standard vendor forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire)
- Banking details + vendor setup in AP system
- Enterprise terms review (our legal team will send redlines if any)

Please see attached MAP_Draft_v2 and let me know if Redwood can own any of the procurement steps (e.g., filling the vendor questionnaire).

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Senior Procurement Lead
Acme Inc.
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx]

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeinc.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)

Hi Sarah — great to connect. Appreciate the clear list. I reviewed your MAP draft and made a few edits; I attached Acme_MAP_Draft_v2 with timeline suggestions. Proposed owners and dates below:

Proposed MAP (milestones, owner, target date, dependencies)
- Complete vendor registration in Ariba/Coupa — Owner: Acme Procurement; Target: 2026-10-15; Dependencies: Acme legal approval (if required)
- Submit vendor forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire) — Owner: Acme (we can pre-fill sections); Target: 2026-10-12; Dependencies: Redwood to provide company EIN and W-9 stub
- Banking details & AP setup — Owner: Acme AP team; Target: 2026-10-20; Dependencies: Valid W-9 + signed contract
- Contract execution / PO issuance — Owner: Acme Legal/Procurement; Target: 2026-10-22; Dependencies: Final terms, SOW, PO creation

We can own: filling in the vendor questionnaire fields and providing a W-9/stub immediately. Rafael (cc'd) will route final W-9 and company banking info to you once we have the signed contract. Dev (cc'd) can help with any technical attestation or SOC 2 evidence if procurement requests specifics.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Acme confirms if Ariba or Coupa (you mentioned both in the call) and which registration portal link to use.
2) Procurement confirms target PO issuance date (we penciled 2026-10-22).
3) I’ll send a completed W-9 and the pre-filled questionnaire fields by EOD 10/05.

If that timeline works, I’ll mark the MAP as agreed and we can move the contract to signatures.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx]

From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-10-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)

Marissa — noted. I can have the W-9 and a W-9 stub (signed) ready by 10/05. Banking details we typically don't send until after countersignature, but we can provide bank name/account holder information to Acme AP for pre-population if needed.

Dev — can you pull the SOC 2 attestation and the standard AWS hosting statement for procurement? Sarah referenced potential questions about data residency controls; having the evidence link will speed the Proc review.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeinc.com>, Acme Inc. Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-05T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa) — Confirming next steps

Hi Sarah and team — quick follow-up to confirm actions and owners. Per our thread: 

Agreed MAP (finalized items)
- 2026-10-12: Acme to submit vendor forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire). Redwood will return a pre-filled questionnaire and W-9 stub by EOD 2026-10-05. (Owner: Acme / Redwood)
- 2026-10-15: Acme completes Ariba/Coupa vendor registration. Please confirm which portal link so we can match fields. (Owner: Acme)
- 2026-10-20: AP completes banking setup and verifies details. Redwood to provide bank name/account holder after countersignature; can provide pre-population fields earlier if required. (Owner: Acme AP / Redwood)
- 2026-10-22: Contract signed & PO issued. (Owner: Acme Legal / Redwood Sales)

Dependencies & risks:
- If Acme requires full bank account numbers before PO, we will need a signed MSA (risk to timeline).
- If Ariba requires a vendor tax ID and we have not provided W-9 stub, registration may be delayed.

Attachments included: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (MAP with owners/timeline), W9_Acme.pdf (W-9 stub). I’ve attached both here and placed the SOC2 attestation link in the related links above for procurement.

Can you confirm acceptance of the MAP and the portal (Ariba vs Coupa) by EOD 10/06 so we can lock dates?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
